usage_guide.hook_slides: Use dramatic or eye-catching photos (1, 2, 5, 6, 13, 23) for slide 1 hooks

power_shots.photo_23: Ultimate 'result' photo - infinity pool/ocean view represents the dream/freedom that hooks promise
power_shots.photo_14: Happy founder on rooftop - shows enjoying the journey, work-life balance achieved
power_shots.photo_9: Team/collaboration - good for co-founder or 'we built this together' narratives
power_shots.photo_5_6: Late night hustle - dedication and sacrifice that leads to success
power_shots.photo_28: X analytics proof - use for credibility slides showing real metrics (9M impressions, 6.79% engagement)
power_shots.photo_29: NativeExpress revenue proof - €25K authentic story with peak+decline graph (use for NativeExpress-specific narratives only)
power_shots.photo_30: Postel revenue proof - €19K authentic SaaS story with peak+decline graph (use for Postel-specific narratives only)
power_shots.photo_31: X monetization proof - $2,476 total payouts, perfect for 'X pays you to market' angle

usage_guide.story_progression: Match photo mood to narrative - workspace for building, outdoor for balance, travel for freedom, casual for authenticity
usage_guide.authenticity: Mix professional workspace shots with casual/travel for realistic founder story - photo 23 is aspirational END GOAL

hook_formula_mapping.conflict: Use workspace photos (1-5) to show the grind/struggle
hook_formula_mapping.showed_them: Use photo 23 (paradise) or 14 (happy rooftop) as the visual 'proof'
hook_formula_mapping.mind_changed: End with results photo that represents freedom/success achieved

selection_tips: Match photo mood to slide message
Use skylight/window photos for aspirational content
Use night/RGB lighting for hustle/dedication narrative
Use outdoor/travel for work-life balance messaging
Use casual for 'real talk' or authentic moments
Photo 23 is your HOOK ANSWER - save it for the payoff slide that shows what changed their mind
Use proof screenshots for credibility slides - showing real metrics builds trust
Photo 28: X analytics (9M impressions) - use for X/social media success stories
Photo 29: NativeExpress revenue (€25K) - use ONLY for NativeExpress-specific stories, NOT for combined €44K narratives
Photo 30: Postel revenue (€19K) - use ONLY for Postel-specific stories, NOT for combined €44K narratives
Photo 31: X payouts ($2,476) - perfect for 'X pays you to market your products' angle, proof of monetization
Authentic decline graphs (photos 29, 30) are more trustworthy than hockey sticks - embrace the real story
When talking about €44K combined revenue, don't use screenshots 29 or 30 (they show individual products)
Photo 31 is powerful for 'getting paid to post' narrative - validates X as monetization platform
